question: How many Table 2 entries use fed-batch cultivation, and how does that compare with shake flask?

trace.query: SELECT row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p9.T2' AND col_no=4 ORDER BY row_no
SELECT row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p9.T2' ORDER BY row_no, col_no
SELECT row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p9.T2' AND row_no>=33 ORDER BY row_no, col_no

SELECT m.text AS mode, COUNT(*) AS entries FROM cells m JOIN cells p ON p.table_id=m.table_id AND p.row_no=m.row_no AND p.col_no=1 WHERE m.table_id='p9.T2' AND m.col_no=4 AND m.row_no>1 AND p.text<>'' GROUP BY m.text ORDER BY entries DESC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.text='fed-batch' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fed_batch, SUM(CASE WHEN m.text='shake flask' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shake_flask, SUM(CASE WHEN m.text='fed-batch' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN m.text='shake flask' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference FROM cells m JOIN cells p ON p.table_id=m.table_id AND p.row_no=m.row_no AND p.col_no=1 WHERE m.table_id='p9.T2' AND m.col_no=4 AND m.row_no>1 AND p.text<>''
